# Clearer Days — ADHD Coaching with Riya Chitnis

> Practical, compassionate ADHD coaching for children, teens and adults. Founded by Riya Chitnis, based in Abu Dhabi and working online worldwide.

Clearer Days is a neurodiversity-affirming ADHD coaching practice designed to help clients bridge the gap between knowing what they want to do and actually beginning. Coaching focuses on practical problem-solving, sustainable habits, time management, and overwhelm reduction without judgment.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://riyachitnis.github.io/): Overview of Clearer Days, core coaching benefits, quick router to key resources, and interactive 60-second breathing reset.
- [Coaching Services & FAQ](https://riyachitnis.github.io/coaching.html): Detailed guide to coaching focus areas (task starting, time blindness, emotional overwhelm, flexible consistency), coaching framework, support options, and FAQ.
- [About Riya Chitnis](https://riyachitnis.github.io/about.html): Professional background of Riya Chitnis (5 years of medical education and clinical experience), coaching values, scope of practice, and multilingual capabilities.

## Practitioner & Practice Details

- **Coach & Founder**: Riya Chitnis
- **Target Clients**: Children, teenagers (under 18 with parental/guardian involvement), and adults.
- **Service Format**: 1:1 online coaching worldwide; in-person coaching in Abu Dhabi, UAE by arrangement.
- **Languages**: English, Hindi, Marathi.
- **Practice Focus**: ADHD, executive function, task initiation, time awareness, routine building, noise reduction, focus.
- **Scope Boundaries**: Coaching is practical and collaborative; non-clinical. It does not provide psychiatric diagnosis, psychotherapy, counselling, or medication management.
- **Consultation & Enquiries**: Free 20-minute initial fit conversation via WhatsApp (+971 50 227 8067).
